sections.title: Page 45
sections.hint: Hamza at the start sits on an alif: أ above for fat-ha and damma, إ below for kasra. Workbook Level 2, page 45 — Hamza. Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.

sections.title: Page 46
sections.hint: In the middle, hamza sits on an alif ـأـ, a waw ؤ, or a nabra ـئـ. Workbook Level 2, page 46 — Hamza. Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.

sections.title: Page 47
sections.hint: At the end, hamza sits on an alif ـأ, a nabra ـئ, or on the line ء. Look! The wavy sign ٓ over a letter of madd means a longer madd. That is the next section! Workbook Level 2, page 47 — Hamza. Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.
